title: decision: leaves advertise required_wire_formats, but not the semiprivate format itself
description:
Mark 2026-11-26. Found by a red test: a room with
`required_wire_formats` in its GroupContext was refused with
`InsufficientCapabilities`.

## Why

RFC 9420 requires every leaf's `capabilities.extensions` to list each
extension type the GroupContext requires. `required_wire_formats` is
extension type 0x0008 (mls-extensions-11 §7.1.3), so a leaf that does
not advertise it can never be in a room that requires any wire format --
including SemiPrivateMessage, which is the whole of epic
mimid-1wgh.4.79.

mimid's leaves advertised only `app_data_dictionary` and a GREASE
codepoint, so no mimid room could have required a wire format at all.

## The decision, in two halves

1. Every mimid leaf advertises extension type 0x0008. This is a claim
   that mimid understands and enforces the extension, which it now does
   (`Observer::required_wire_formats`, and the hub's check that a room
   requiring the semiprivate format lists an external receiver). It
   costs two octets in every LeafNode and broke no existing test.

2. mimid does NOT advertise `supported_wire_formats` (0x0007) with
   `mls_semiprivate_message` in it. That would claim mimid can read and
   send a SemiPrivateMessage as a member, and mimid cannot send one yet
   (bead mimid-1wgh.4.79.3 needs a WireFormat variant in the openmls
   patch). Advertising it would invite a room mimid would then fail in.

The distinction matters: supporting the extension that negotiates wire
formats is not the same as supporting any given format. Conflating them
is how an implementation ends up in a room it cannot speak in.

## What this makes true

A mimid room can now require a wire format. It cannot yet require
mls_semiprivate_message usefully, because mimid members cannot produce
one -- the hub can only read what another implementation sends. That is
bead mimid-1wgh.4.79.3.

Item 11 for bead mimid-1wgh.44.22: semiprivatemessage-08 §3 L173-179
lists two conditions for using SemiPrivateMessage and omits a third that
RFC 9420 imposes -- every leaf must support extension type 0x0008, or
the group cannot carry required_wire_formats at all. Same omission in
kind as item 8's component negotiation.
